fields.summary: Pagination broken on search results page
fields.description:
When searching for items and navigating to page 2 or beyond, the URL updates but the results shown are still from page 1. The pagination controls display the correct page number but the data is wrong.

Affects all search queries. Reproduced on Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.

comments.body: Reproduced. The offset parameter is not being passed to the API call.
Is there any update on this fix? It's affecting our users daily.
